$schema_comment: Per-client tracking config. Lives at <ClientFolder>/.tracking.json. Values marked <FILL> are placeholders; *_env keys carry the NAME of the env var, never the value.
client_code: <FILL: short uppercase code, e.g. LL, ET, KM>
site_path: <FILL: relative path from ClientFolder, e.g. site or website>

sidecar.needed: <FILL: true for vite-react-spa, false for nextjs-app-router>

meta._help: Get pixel_id from Events Manager. Generate CAPI token at Events Manager → Settings → Conversions API → Generate Access Token. Leave test_event_code_env empty in production.

conversion_labels._help: One label per event type: { "Lead": "abc/xyz", "Purchase": "abc/qrs" }. Generated in Google Ads → Tools → Conversions → New conversion action.

google_ads._help: conversion_id format: AW-123456789. Enhanced Conversions for Web fires automatically via gtag once user_data is set.

ga4._help: measurement_id format: G-XXXXXXXXX. api_secret generated in GA4 Admin → Data Streams → Web → Measurement Protocol API secrets. region: 'us' or 'eu' (region1.google-analytics.com).

tiktok._help: pixel_id is a hex string from TikTok Events Manager. Access token generated at Events Manager → Settings → Generate Access Token.

consent._help: lgpd_mode: 'off' (no gating, pixels fire freely) | 'gated' (banner blocks pixels until accept). When 'gated': default_state controls pre-interaction behavior, granular adds per-purpose toggles, banner: 'external' (you have your own) | 'builtin' (use assets/lgpd-consent-banner.tsx).

events.name: PageView
events._help: Universal event name. See references/universal-event-layer.md for name mapping per platform.

params._help: Static params per fire. Dynamic params (email, phone) are passed at call site.
